recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, intimate portrait of a man in a cowboy hat leaning forward on a bed, utilizing a soft-focus background and a earthy, sepia-influenced color palette with bold, condensed typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning from the left into the center-right negative space
Contrast between the crisp white linen shirt and the warm tan background
Horizontal rule separating primary display text from secondary metadata
Tight vertical alignment of text blocks on the right side
coreInvariants: Presence of a wide-brimmed felt cowboy hat
Soft, diffused indoor lighting creating gentle shadows
Earthy, desaturated color palette (tans, browns, creams, faded denim)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, leaning diagonally towards the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hat in the upper left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the face, follows the diagonal line of the shoulder down to the hands, then moves right to the text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the upper right quadrant to accommodate large-scale typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm tan/beige background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white of the linen shirt.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep brown of the hat and dark blue of the denim jeans.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a warm, golden-hour value shift.
paletteRestrictions: Focus on ochre and umber tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed, high-waisted serif and wide, extended slab-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses extreme vertical compression with thick vertical strokes and thin horizontal serifs.
Secondary text uses wide tracking and a heavier, more traditional serif structure.
A hand-drawn or textured horizontal line separates the two tiers.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over negative space of background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Vertical condensed vs. horizontal extended contrast.

preserve: Condensed nature of the primary text
Wide tracking of the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, high-contrast serif display style.
Matches the wide, small-cap feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a man in a brown cowboy hat and a white linen shirt, leaning forward on a bed with white pillows. The background is a plain, warm-toned wall. Soft, warm lighting. High-quality photography, shallow depth of field.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary text in a large, condensed brown serif font in the upper right. Draw a rough black horizontal line underneath it. Below the line, add secondary text in a smaller, wide-tracked black slab-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the cowboy hat clearly visible?
Is the text condensed and vertically prominent?
Is the color palette warm and earthy?
Is there a horizontal divider line between text blocks?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the shirt looks like natural linen
Check that the text is legible against the background
Verify the diagonal composition of the subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a relaxed, rustic portrait with high-contrast condensed serif typography and a warm, desaturated color grade.
